integrity: The unrestricted formulas and uniqueness are analytically proved. Finite exact sign checks and numerical quadrature are corroboration only. No independent mathematical audit is represented.
limitations: Central Haar planes through the centroid of right equilateral triangular prisms only; not randomly translated sections, silhouettes, or non-equilateral bases. Older angle-distribution and stereology full texts were not accessible, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Exact ternary central-section law and a unique pentagon-optimal aspect ratio for triangular prisms
